svg.title: Core budget tables
svg.desc: A request has cost lines and a review row. A batch holds a result per request. An appropriation has allocation lines, and each line has plans, ledger entries, transfers and carry-overs.

g.font-family: 'Leelawadee UI', Tahoma, 'Noto Sans Thai', Anuphan, sans-serif
